info.name: TeamHub API
info.description:
TeamHub backend (Spring Boot) — company operations platform: people, attendance, leave, payroll, scheduling, assets, vendors, expenses, incidents/on-call, announcements, policy documents, resource booking, and the Board Room.

**Getting started**
1. Run `Auth > Login` first (uses the seeded bootstrap account admin@ems.com / Admin@123). This stores the session both as cookies (Postman's cookie jar resends them automatically) and as the `accessToken`/`refreshToken` collection variables.
2. A collection-level pre-request script attaches `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` automatically to every request once it is set, so you never have to configure auth per-request.
3. Work through folders top to bottom the first time — many "Create" requests save the id they return into a collection variable (e.g. `departmentId`, `employeeId`) that later requests in this collection already reference.

Base URL defaults to `http://localhost:8080/api/v1` (the `/api/v1` context-path is configured in application.yml) — change the `baseUrl` collection variable if your server runs elsewhere.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login, session refresh, and password management. Every other folder in this collection depends on running Login first.

request.description: Authenticates and sets accessToken/refreshToken as HttpOnly cookies. Also populates {{accessToken}}/{{refreshToken}} collection variables for requests that need an explicit Bearer header. Seeded bootstrap account: admin@ems.com / Admin@123.

exec: // The access/refresh tokens are only ever sent as HttpOnly cookies (never in the JSON body).
// Postman's cookie jar will already resend them automatically on this domain, but we also
// parse them into collection variables here as a fallback (Newman, cookie jar disabled, etc.)
// and so the pre-request script below can attach an explicit Authorization header too.

request.description: departmentId must exist (run Create Department first). roleIds is optional. A temporary password is generated and emailed to the given address; a linked user account is created automatically.
All query params are optional filters (EmployeeQuerySearch). Non-HR/Admin/SuperAdmin callers only see their own department.

item.description: employeeUserId (the linked user id of an employee, not the employee id itself) comes from Employees > Create Employee.

item.name: Board Room
item.description: Requires the current user to be a Board Room member (the seeded admin@ems.com account is auto-enrolled).
